title: Fantastic tapas experience!
text:
We loved our private tapas tour! Our guide Irma was outstanding. She was very knowledgeable about Spain’s history and Barcelona culture. We enjoyed talking and laughing with her during this tour. 

I can’t eat gluten, but that didn’t get communicated to her by our travel agent. She wasn’t flustered by this challenge. Irma was able to ensure each restaurant had gluten free options for us. 

This was a top notch experience. I highly recommend tours by Thrills and especially with Irma.
author: McWag_SF
